chat.description: A chat between the participants of a room, their messages sent peer to peer.
chat.title: Chat

chess.description: Chess where both players move at the same time: each one picks a move without knowing the other's.
chess.title: Synchronous chess

home.intro: Create a room, or join one of the open rooms: the players connect directly to each other.

poker.description: Heads-up poker with a deck of 17 cards that no one deals: the players shuffle it together, encrypted.
poker.title: Seventeen poker

roulette.description: A duel with a revolver of 24 chambers, where each player loads its own bullets: shoot, or pay to pass.
roulette.title: Russian roulette

home.title: Choose a game

booting.delay: The server and its database sleep when nobody plays: waking them up takes up to about thirty seconds.
